summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the declaration of monthly distributions for May 2026 across its seven classes of common stock. Gross distribution was $0.1600 per share; net amounts ranged from $0.1420 to $0.1600 after stockholder servicing fees. Record date is May 31, 2026, payable on or about June 12, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, tender offer, or restructuring is involved.
